{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Stratify by customer_segment and compute average revenue in each channel within each segment
stratified_avg = completed_orders.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')

# Compute the difference in average revenue within each segment (email - paid_search)
differences = stratified_avg['email'] - stratified_avg['paid_search']

# Display the results
print(stratified_avg)
print('\nDifferences (email - paid_search) per segment:')
print(differences)"}
